summary: Cardiol Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 23, 2026 news release announcing that its pivotal Phase III MAVERIC trial of CardiolRx in recurrent pericarditis reached its original 110-patient enrollment target ahead of end-September guidance. A blinded review showed fewer-than-expected recurrences, prompting the Steering Committee to recommend expanding enrollment to up to 150 patients to preserve statistical power. Topline results are now expected mid-2027 versus prior Q1 2027 guidance, with existing capital funding completion and cash runway into Q1 2028. This is a routine clinical-operations update, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation apply.
